defects.defect: The cleanup procedure has no backup step. There is no export of the matched Review__c records (for example, sf data export or query to CSV) before the delete, only a roll-up baseline and reliance on the 15-day Recycle Bin. meta.expect calls for a cleanup procedure with backup.
defects.skill_gap: None exists: SKILL.md has no guidance for data-operation requirements, such as requiring a backup or export step in any destructive procedure.

defects.defect: It asked the user a scope question (zero-change spec, marker field, or purge batch) even though a recommended default was available and meta.expect.should_ask_user is false. The user answered 'no preference', confirming the default was enough.
defects.skill_gap: SKILL.md Step 5 does not cover a 'premise false / matches 0 records' case or data-only requests, so the run could not tell whether to ask. A rule like 'when a safe zero-change default exists, record it as an open decision instead of asking' would have prevented this.

defects.defect: Section 6 says the CLI user 'needs Delete and Modify All on Review__c'. Modify All is not required. Delete on Review__c plus edit access to the master Storefront__c record (OWD ReadWrite here) is enough. This overstated platform requirement sits next to 'verified by org query', which only covers the grant listing.
defects.skill_gap: None exists specifically: the provenance rule does not separate verified org facts from platform-behavior inferences written in the same sentence.
